oneOf.description: Opens an address. It is content: a reader shows or opens it only when a person clicks.
Goes to a slide of this presentation.
Goes back to the slide shown before this one.
Names a program to run. A conformant reader NEVER runs it; it is kept so that the document round-trips.

path.description: The program, as the author wrote it.

oneOf.description: Starts or stops the media of the shape that carries the action.

autofit.description: What happens when text does not fit its shape.

font_scale.description: Factor every font size is multiplied by, 0..1 (1 = not shrunk).

line_reduction.description: Fraction by which line spacing is reduced, 0..1 (0 = not reduced).

oneOf.description: The shape grows to fit the text.

background.description: The background of a slide, layout or master.

fill.description: The fill, painted over the whole slide.

oneOf.description: One of the master theme's background fills.

color.description: The colour substituted for `phClr` in that fill.

body_props.description: Properties of a text body. Every member may be null or absent: inherited (section 4.6).

anchor.description: Vertical position of the text block in the text area.

anchor_ctr.description: The text block is also centred horizontally as a whole.

autofit.description: What happens when text does not fit.

inset_l.description: Left inset of the text area inside the shape's text rectangle, points. Inherited default 7.2.

rot.description: Extra rotation of the text block in degrees, clockwise.

upright.description: The text stays upright when the shape is rotated.

vert.description: Text direction: `vertical` = rotated 90 degrees clockwise, `vertical270` = 270 degrees, `stacked` = upright letters stacked top to bottom, `eaVertical` = East Asian vertical.

warp.description: A text-warp preset name (e.g. `textArchUp`); a reader that does not implement it draws the text unwarped.

wrap.description: Lines wrap at the text area's width (true) or run on (false).

scheme.description: Number format: `arabicPeriod` (1.), `arabicParenR` (1)), `arabicParenBoth` ((1)), `arabicPlain` (1), `romanUcPeriod` (I.), `romanLcPeriod` (i.), `alphaUcPeriod` (A.), `alphaLcPeriod` (a.), `alphaLcParenR` (a)), `alphaUcParenR` (A)), `circleNumDbPlain` (circled digits). An unknown scheme is drawn as `arabicPeriod`.

start_at.description: The number of the first paragraph of the run. Absent = 1.

media.description: The `id` of the media asset drawn as the bullet.

chart_series.description: One data series of a chart.

data_labels.description: Value labels on this series; null = follow the chart's `data_labels`.

fill.description: The series' fill; null = the next palette colour.

kind.description: In a `combo` chart: this series' own chart type; null = the chart's.

line.description: The series' line or outline; null = automatic.

marker.description: Marker of a line or scatter series: `none`, `circle`, `square`, `diamond`, `triangle`, `x`, `star`, `dot`, `dash`, `plus`; null = automatic.

name.description: The series name (legend entry). Default empty.

point_fills.description: Fills of individual points (pie slices). Default empty.

secondary_axis.description: The series is plotted against a second value axis on the right. Default false.

sizes.description: Bubble sizes of a `bubble` series. Default empty.

smooth.description: A line series is drawn as a smooth curve. Default false.

values.description: The y values, one per category. Default empty.

items.description: One value; null = no data for that category.

x_values.description: The x values of a `scatter` or `bubble` series, one per point; empty for other types. Default empty.

color.description: A colour as the document states it: a base and an ordered list of transforms. Resolve the base to RGBA, then apply the transforms in order (section 4.3).

oneOf.description: A slot of the theme's colour scheme.

slot.description: The slot. `dk1`..`folHlink` are the twelve theme colours (the master's `theme.colors.colors`, in that order). `bg1`, `tx1`, `bg2`, `tx2` are aliases resolved through the master's `color_map` (default: bg1 = lt1, tx1 = dk1, bg2 = lt2, tx2 = dk2). `phClr` is the colour a theme style entry is applied with (a shape's `style.*_ref.color`); outside a theme style it is `accent1`.

name.description: A CSS/SVG colour keyword in lower camel case (`red`, `cornflowerBlue`, `darkSlateGray`); an unknown name is black.

oneOf.description: A colour of the operating system's scheme, with the value it had when the document was saved.

last.description: The value to use: readers do not ask the operating system.

mods.description: Transforms applied in order. Absent = none.

color_transform.description: One step of a colour's transform list. PROFILE-PRESENTATION.md section 4.3 gives the arithmetic of every `op`.

val.description: The operand: a percentage in thousandths of a percent (100000 = 100 %) for every op except `hueOff`, whose operand is an angle in 60000ths of a degree. Absent for `comp`, `inv` and `gray`, which take none.

custom_path.description: One sub-path of a custom geometry.

d.description: Path commands separated by spaces, absolute coordinates: `M x y` move to; `L x y` line to; `C x1 y1 x2 y2 x y` cubic Bezier with control points (x1,y1), (x2,y2) to (x,y); `Q x1 y1 x y` quadratic Bezier; `Z` close the sub-path. Default empty.

fill.description: How the sub-path is filled: `norm` = the shape's fill; `none` = not filled; `lighten` / `lightenLess` = the fill mixed 40 % / 20 % towards white; `darken` / `darkenLess` = mixed 40 % / 20 % towards black. Default `norm`.

h.description: Height of the path's coordinate space, likewise. Default 0.

stroke.description: The sub-path is outlined with the shape's line. Default true.

w.description: Width of the path's own coordinate space; the path is scaled so that `w` maps to the shape's width. 0 or less = the path is already in points. Default 0.

name.description: `solid`, or one of these, given as (dash, space) lengths in multiples of the line width: `dot` 1,3; `dash` 4,3; `lgDash` 8,3; `dashDot` 4,3,1,3; `lgDashDot` 8,3,1,3; `lgDashDotDot` 8,3,1,3,1,3; `sysDash` 3,1; `sysDot` 1,1; `sysDashDot` 3,1,1,1; `sysDashDotDot` 3,1,1,1,1,1. An unknown name is solid.

pattern.description: Dashes and spaces, repeated along the line.

items.description: One dash and the space after it.

dash.description: Dash length in multiples of the line width.

space.description: Space length in multiples of the line width.

effects.description: Effects of a shape. null members = that effect is absent.

bevel.description: A bevel preset name (`circle`, `relaxedInset`, `cross`, `coolSlant`, `angle`, `softRound`, `convex`, `slope`, `divot`, `riblet`, `hardEdge`, `artDeco`); a reader may draw it as a soft highlight or not at all.

soft_edge.description: The outline fades to transparent over this many points.

rotate_with_shape.description: The gradient turns with the shape when it is rotated. Absent = true.

stops.description: Colour stops, ascending by `pos`; between two stops colours are interpolated linearly in sRGB.

adjust.description: Corrections applied to the picture's pixels before it is drawn. Default: none.

alpha.description: Opacity of the picture, 0.0 (invisible) to 1.0 (opaque). null = opaque.

crop.description: Source crop: the fraction of the picture cut away at its left, top, right and bottom edge, in that order. 0 = nothing cut; a negative value adds empty margin on that side. Default [0, 0, 0, 0].

items.description: Fraction of the picture's width (left, right) or height (top, bottom).

media.description: The `id` of the media asset whose picture fills the box (resolve it through the structure node's `media` table). Default 0, which names no asset: the box is then empty.

mode.description: How the (cropped) picture is laid into the box. Default: stretch with a zero inset.

fg.description: The colour of the pattern's marks.

preset.description: Pattern name, e.g. `pct5`..`pct90` (dot densities), `horz`, `vert`, `ltHorz`, `dkVert`, `ltUpDiag`, `dkDnDiag`, `cross`, `diagCross`, `smGrid`, `lgGrid`, `smCheck`, `lgCheck`, `wave`, `zigZag`, `diagBrick`, `horzBrick`, `plaid`, `sphere`, `weave`, `trellis`, `shingle`, `divot`, `dotGrid`, `dotDmnd`, `solidDmnd`, `openDmnd`, `smConfetti`, `lgConfetti`, `wdUpDiag`, `wdDnDiag`, `narHorz`, `narVert`, `dashHorz`, `dashVert`, `dashUpDiag`, `dashDnDiag`. A reader that does not know the name paints the average of the two colours.

oneOf.description: The fill of the group that contains the shape.
The slide's background shows through, as if the shape were a window in everything beneath it.

geom.description: A shape's outline, in the shape's own space: (0,0) is the box's top-left corner, (w,h) its bottom-right.

oneOf.description: A named outline. Section 4.4 defines `rect`, `ellipse`, `roundRect`, `triangle`, `diamond`, `line` and says where the outline of every other name is found (the `core.slide.geometry` node).

adj.description: Adjust values in the preset's own order: ratios in 1/100000 of the shorter side (or of the width or height) and angles in 1/60000 degree. Absent or short = the preset's defaults.

oneOf.description: Colours change along a straight line through the box.

angle.description: Direction in degrees, clockwise on screen: 0 = left to right, 90 = top to bottom.

scaled.description: The angle is measured in a box stretched to a square (so 45 degrees runs corner to corner). Absent = false.

oneOf.description: Colours change outward from a focus point to the farthest corner of the box (section 4.5).

focus.description: The focus rectangle, whose centre is where position 0 of the stops is: its inset from the box's left, top, right and bottom edge as fractions. [0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5] is the centre point of the box.

path.description: The shape of the contours: `circle`, `rect` or `shape` (following the outline). A reader may draw all three as circles.

gradient_stop.description: One colour stop of a gradient.

hyperlink.description: A click action on text or on a shape.

highlight_click.description: The shape is highlighted while it is pressed. Absent = false.

tooltip.description: Text shown on hover. Absent = empty.

line.description: An outline. Every member may be null: that member is then inherited (placeholder chain, then the shape's theme style, then: no line).

cap.description: How the ends of the line and of each dash are finished; inherited default `flat`.

compound.description: Parallel sub-lines the stroke is split into; inherited default `single`.

fill.description: What the line is painted with (`none` = no line).

head.description: Arrowhead at the START of the path.

join.description: How corners are finished; inherited default `round`. A miter longer than 8 line widths is bevelled.

tail.description: Arrowhead at the END of the path.

len.description: Length relative to the line width: `sm` (2x), `med` (3x), `lg` (5x). Absent = `med`.

w.description: Width relative to the line width: `sm` (2x), `med` (3x), `lg` (5x). Absent = `med`.

levels.description: Index 0 is outline level 0 (the top level), up to index 8. Default empty.

items.description: The defaults of one level; null = not specified.

para_props.description: Paragraph formatting. Every member may be null or absent: inherited (section 4.6).

align.description: Horizontal alignment. `justLow` = justified with kashida elongation; `distributed` = justified including the last line.

bullet_color.description: Bullet colour; null = the text colour.

bullet_font.description: Font family of the bullet character; null = the text font.

bullet_size.description: Bullet size as a fraction of the text size (1.0 = same size).

default_tab.description: Distance between default tab stops in points.

font_align.description: Vertical alignment of glyphs of different sizes on a line: `auto`, `t` top, `ctr` centre, `base` baseline, `b` bottom.

indent.description: Offset of the first line (and of the bullet) from `margin_left` in points; negative = hanging indent.

margin_left.description: Left margin of the paragraph in points, from the text area's left edge.

align.description: `l` left, `ctr` centred, `r` right, `dec` aligned on the decimal point.

pos.description: Position in points from the text area's left edge.

end_props.description: Formatting of the paragraph mark: what text typed into an empty paragraph gets. Absent = none.

level.description: Outline level, 0 (top) .. 8; selects the level of every list style consulted. Default 0.

props.description: The paragraph's own formatting. Absent = none.

runs.description: The runs, in reading order. Default empty (an empty paragraph).

picture_adjust.description: Corrections applied to a picture's pixels (non-destructive: the embedded picture is unchanged).

brightness.description: -1.0 (black) .. 1.0 (white); 0 = unchanged: each channel c (0..1) becomes c + brightness, clamped. Default 0.

clear_color.description: Pixels of exactly this colour are drawn transparent; null = none.

contrast.description: -1.0 .. 1.0; 0 = unchanged: each channel becomes (c - 0.5) * (1 + contrast) + 0.5, clamped. Default 0.

duotone.description: Recolour: the picture's luminance is mapped onto a ramp between two colours.

grayscale.description: The picture is drawn in grey. Default false.

picture_fill.description: A picture drawn into a box.

adjust.description: Corrections applied to the picture's pixels before it is drawn. Default: none.

alpha.description: Opacity of the picture, 0.0 (invisible) to 1.0 (opaque). null = opaque.

crop.description: Source crop: the fraction of the picture cut away at its left, top, right and bottom edge, in that order. 0 = nothing cut; a negative value adds empty margin on that side. Default [0, 0, 0, 0].

items.description: Fraction of the picture's width (left, right) or height (top, bottom).

media.description: The `id` of the media asset whose picture fills the box (resolve it through the structure node's `media` table). Default 0, which names no asset: the box is then empty.

mode.description: How the (cropped) picture is laid into the box. Default: stretch with a zero inset.

picture_mode.description: How a picture is laid into its box.

oneOf.description: The picture is stretched to the box, inset by `fill_rect`.

fill_rect.description: Inset of the picture from the box's left, top, right and bottom edge as fractions of the box's width (left, right) and height (top, bottom); negative values make it larger than the box. Absent = [0, 0, 0, 0].

oneOf.description: The picture is repeated across the box.

align.description: Which point of the box the tiling starts from: `tl`, `t`, `tr`, `l`, `ctr`, `r`, `bl`, `b`, `br`. Absent = `tl`.

flip.description: Mirroring of alternate tiles: empty or `none`, `x`, `y`, `xy`. Absent = none.

sx.description: Horizontal scale of a tile, 1.0 = the picture's size at 72 pixels per inch.

tx.description: Horizontal offset of the first tile in points.

ty.description: Vertical offset of the first tile in points.

placeholder.description: Marks a shape as a placeholder: it inherits box, formatting and text styles from the placeholder of the same `kind` and `idx` on its layout, and that one from the master (section 4.6).

has_custom_prompt.description: The layout's placeholder carries its own prompt text. Default false.

idx.description: Index that pairs it with the layout's placeholder. Default 0.

kind.description: What the placeholder is for. `ctrTitle` = centred title, `subTitle` = subtitle, `obj` = any content, `slideNum` = slide number, `slideImage` = the slide's picture on a notes page. Default `body`.

reflection.description: A mirrored, fading copy below the shape.

dist.description: Gap between the shape and its reflection in points.

end_pos.description: How much of the shape's height is reflected, 0..1.

start_alpha.description: Opacity of the reflection at the shape's edge, 0..1.

rgba.description: An sRGB colour with straight (not premultiplied) alpha.

run.description: A run of characters with one formatting.

oneOf.description: A line break inside the paragraph.
A field the reader fills in.

field.description: `slidenum` = the slide's number (its position in the show, 0-based, plus the structure node's `first_slide_number`); `datetime`, `datetime1`..`datetime13` = the current date/time in one of thirteen formats; `footer` = the structure node's `header_footer.footer_text`. A reader shows `text` for a field it does not compute.

oneOf.description: An equation. Its typeset form (OMML) is kept in the owner's x.deckcraft.ooxml node; `text` is its linear form.

props.description: The run's own formatting. Absent = none (all inherited).

text.description: The characters. For a `field` run: the field's last displayed value. For a `math` run: the equation in linear form. For a `break` run: unused (the run contributes one line break). Default empty.

run_props.description: Character formatting. Every member may be null or absent: it is then inherited (section 4.6).

baseline.description: Baseline shift as a fraction of the font size: 0.3 = superscript raised 30 %, -0.25 = subscript lowered 25 %; 0 = none.

caps.description: Capitalisation applied at display: small capitals or all capitals; the stored text is unchanged.

fill.description: Text fill (its colour is a `solid` fill).

font.description: Latin font family name, or a theme reference: `+mj-lt` = the theme's major (heading) Latin font, `+mn-lt` = its minor (body) Latin font.

highlight.description: Highlight colour painted behind the text.

kern.description: Pair kerning is applied at and above this font size in points; 0 = never.

lang.description: Language of the text as a BCP 47 tag, e.g. `en-US`.

no_proof.description: The text is exempt from spelling and grammar checking.

spacing.description: Extra space after each character in points; negative tightens.

underline.description: Underline style token: `none`, `sng` (single), `dbl` (double), `heavy`, `dotted`, `dash`, `dashLong`, `dotDash`, `dotDotDash`, `wavy`, `wavyDbl`, `words` (single, words only). A reader draws an unknown token as `sng`.

underline_color.description: Underline colour; absent/null = the text colour.

align.description: The point of the shape the scale and skew are anchored to: `tl`, `t`, `tr`, `l`, `ctr`, `r`, `bl`, `b`, `br`. Absent = empty = `b`.

color.description: Shadow colour, including its transparency (an `alpha` transform).

dir.description: Direction of the offset in degrees, clockwise on screen: 0 = to the right, 90 = downwards.

dist.description: Distance of the shadow from the shape in points.

inner.description: The shadow is cast inside the shape. Absent = false.

rotate_with_shape.description: The offset direction turns with the shape. Absent = true.

sx.description: Horizontal scale of the shadow, 1.0 = the shape's size. Absent = 1.

shape.description: One object on a slide, layout or master.

click.description: What clicking the shape does in a slide show.

decorative.description: The shape is decoration and is skipped by screen readers. Default false.

descr.description: Alternative text for assistive technology. Default empty.

fill.description: The fill; null = inherited (placeholder chain, then `style.fill_ref`, then none).

hidden.description: The shape is not drawn. Default false.

hover.description: What moving the pointer over the shape does.

id.description: The shape's id: unique among the shapes of its slide (including group members) and stable for the shape's life. Animations, comments and connectors name shapes by it. Default 0.

locked.description: The shape cannot be selected or moved in the editor. Default false.

name.description: The shape's name as shown in the selection pane. Default empty.

ph.description: Present when the shape is a placeholder.

text.description: The shape's text; null = it has none.

text_box.description: The shape was made as a text box: it has no fill or line of its own and grows with its text unless it says otherwise. Default false.

title.description: Title of the alternative text. Default empty.

xfrm.description: The shape's box; null = a placeholder that takes its box from the matching placeholder of its layout, then master.

oneOf.description: An autoshape or a text box: outline `geom`, painted with `fill` and `line`, holding `text`.
A picture drawn into the shape's box and clipped to `geom`.
A group: its children are positioned in the child space `child`, which is mapped onto the group's own box (section 4.2).

child.description: The child coordinate space: the rectangle of child coordinates that the group's box shows.

oneOf.description: A line that may be glued to other shapes. An end that is absent or null is free.

shape.description: `id` of the shape it is glued to (on the same slide).

site.description: 0-based index of that shape's connection site.

band_col.description: Alternate columns are shaded. Default false.

band_row.description: Alternate rows are shaded. Default true.

cols.description: Column widths in points, left to right. The table's width is their sum.

items.description: Width of one column in points.

first_col.description: The first column takes the style's emphasis formatting. Default false.

first_row.description: The first row is a header row and takes the style's header formatting. Default true.

last_col.description: The last column takes the style's emphasis formatting. Default false.

last_row.description: The last row is a total row. Default false.

rows.description: Rows, top to bottom. Every row has one cell per column.

style.description: Table style: one of this application's style names (`none`, `grid`, or `<family>-<colour>` with family `light1`, `light2`, `medium2`, `medium4`, `dark1` and colour `tx1` or `accent1`..`accent6`), or the style GUID of an imported file. A reader that does not know the name draws cells with their own fills and borders only. Default `medium2-accent1`.

oneOf.description: A chart; its data is in the object itself.

category.description: Title of the category (x) axis; null = none.

value.description: Title of the value (y) axis; null = none.

categories.description: Category labels, in order; point i of every series belongs to category i.

chart_fill.description: Fill of the whole chart box; null = none.

data_labels.description: Value labels are shown on every series that does not say otherwise. Default false.

gap_width.description: Gap between category groups as a multiple of one bar's width. Default 2.19.

gridlines.description: Major gridlines of the value axis are drawn. Default true.

hole_size.description: Doughnut hole diameter as a fraction of the outer diameter, 0..1. Default 0.5.

kind.description: The chart type. `column`/`bar` are clustered vertical/horizontal bars; `stacked*` stack the series; `percent*` stack them to 100 %; `combo` draws each series as its own `kind`. Default `column`.

legend.description: Legend position: `b` bottom, `t` top, `l` left, `r` right, `tr` top right; null = no legend. (Always written: a chart object without it is read as `b`.)

overlap.description: Overlap of adjacent bars within a group as a fraction of a bar's width; negative = a gap. Default -0.27.

palette.description: Colour palette name. A name beginning `monochrome` gives every series a shade of `accent1`; any other name (the application writes `colorful1`) gives series i the theme colour accent(1 + i mod 6). A series with its own `fill` ignores it. Default `colorful1`.

plot_fill.description: Fill of the plot area; null = none.

series.description: The data series, in legend order.

style.description: Chart style number, 1..48 (a look from the application's gallery); readers may ignore it. Default 2.

text_color.description: Colour of all chart text; null = the theme's text colour.

title.description: The chart title; null = no title. (The member is always written: a chart object without it is read as having the title `Chart Title`.)

vary_colors.description: Each POINT (not each series) takes the next palette colour: pies and single-series charts. Default false.

y_max.description: Fixed maximum of the value axis; null = automatic.

y_min.description: Fixed minimum of the value axis; null = automatic.

autoplay.description: Start when the slide appears rather than on click. Default false.

ms.description: Its position in milliseconds from the start of the file.

duration_ms.description: Length of the file in milliseconds as the writer measured it; 0 = unknown.

full_screen.description: Play filling the screen. Default false.

height.description: Picture height of a video in pixels; 0 = unknown.

hide_while_not_playing.description: The shape is invisible unless it is playing. Default false.

media.description: The `id` of the media asset that holds the audio or video file (structure node `media` table). Default 0 = none.

play_across_slides.description: Keep playing after the show leaves the slide. Default false.

poster.description: The `id` of the media asset (a picture) shown before playback starts; null = the first frame, or the icon.

rewind.description: Return to the first frame after playing. Default false.

trim_end_ms.description: Playback stops this many milliseconds BEFORE the end of the file. Default 0.

trim_start_ms.description: Playback starts this many milliseconds into the file. Default 0.

video.description: true: a video, drawn in the shape's box. false: audio, shown as an icon. Default false.

volume.description: Linear gain, 0.0 (silent) to 1.0 (unchanged). Default 0.0 in an object written by hand; the application writes 1.0 for new clips.

width.description: Picture width of a video in pixels as the writer measured it; 0 = unknown.

highlighter.description: A highlighter: drawn at 50 % opacity with square ends. Default false.

points.description: Samples along the stroke, in drawing order; consecutive samples are joined by straight segments. Default empty.

pressure.description: Pen pressure, 0..1; the stroke's width at this point is `width` times the pressure (1 where the device has none).

width.description: Nominal stroke width in points. Default 0.

oneOf.description: An object this application does not model (a diagram, an embedded document). Its original XML is kept in the owner's x.deckcraft.ooxml node; a reader draws `preview` in the shape's box, or a labelled frame.

label.description: A short description of what the object is.

preview.description: The `id` of the media asset with a picture of the object; null = none.

shape_style.description: A shape's references into the master theme's format scheme. Members of the shape itself (`fill`, `line`, `effects`) that are not null win over these.

color.description: The colour substituted for `phClr` inside that theme entry.

index.description: 1-based index into the master theme's format list (`theme.format.lines`, `fills` or `effects`); 0 = none. For a fill, 1001..1003 index `bg_fills`.

color.description: The colour substituted for `phClr` inside that theme entry.

index.description: 1-based index into the master theme's format list (`theme.format.lines`, `fills` or `effects`); 0 = none. For a fill, 1001..1003 index `bg_fills`.

font_ref.description: The theme font of the shape's text.

color.description: Colour of the shape's text; null = inherited.

font.description: `major` (the theme's heading font), `minor` (its body font) or `none`.

line_ref.description: The theme line the outline is taken from.

color.description: The colour substituted for `phClr` inside that theme entry.

index.description: 1-based index into the master theme's format list (`theme.format.lines`, `fills` or `effects`); 0 = none. For a fill, 1001..1003 index `bg_fills`.

spacing.description: A vertical distance in one of two units.

kind.description: `pct`: `v` is a multiple of the line's natural height (1.0 = single spacing). `pts`: `v` is in points.

anchor.description: Vertical position of the text in the cell; null = top.

borders.description: The left, right, top and bottom border, in that order. Default four nulls.

items.description: One border; null = from the table style.

diag_down.description: Diagonal from the top-left to the bottom-right corner; null = none.

diag_up.description: Diagonal from the bottom-left to the top-right corner; null = none.

fill.description: The cell's fill; null = from the table style.

grid_span.description: Number of columns this cell spans (1 = itself). Default 0 in a hand-written object, read as 1.

h_merge.description: This cell is covered by a cell to its left that spans it; it draws nothing. Default false.

margins.description: Inner margins: left, right, top, bottom, in points; null = 7.2, 7.2, 3.6, 3.6.

row_span.description: Number of rows this cell spans (1 = itself). Default 0, read as 1.

v_merge.description: This cell is covered by a cell above that spans it. Default false.

vertical.description: Text direction in the cell; null = horizontal.

cells.description: The row's cells, left to right, one per column. Default empty.

height.description: Row height in points (the row grows if its text needs more). Default 0.

text_body.description: The text of a shape, a table cell or the speaker notes.

list_style.description: The body's own per-level defaults. Absent = none.

paragraphs.description: The paragraphs, in order. Default empty.

xfrm.description: A box: where a shape is in its parent's coordinate space (the slide, or its group's child space). The box is the rectangle (x, y)-(x + w, y + h); rotation and flips are about its centre and are applied flip first, then rotation.

rot.description: Rotation in degrees, clockwise on screen. Absent = 0.

y.description: Top edge in points (y grows downwards). Default 0.

description: One master: the theme and the defaults every layout and slide built on it inherits. Its layouts are separate core.slide.layout nodes.

background.description: The background of every slide that does not set its own; null = white.

body_style.description: Text defaults of body placeholders (`body`, `subTitle`, `obj` and the rest). Default empty.

color_map.description: How the alias slots map onto theme colours. Empty = bg1 -> lt1, tx1 -> dk1, bg2 -> lt2, tx2 -> dk2.

slot.description: The theme slot it stands for, e.g. `lt1`.

other_style.description: Text defaults of shapes that are not placeholders. Default empty.

preserve.description: The master is kept even when no slide uses it. Default false.

shapes.description: The master's shapes, bottom first: placeholders that give every layout and slide its defaults, and fixed shapes drawn on every slide. Default empty.

theme.description: The master's theme: twelve colours, two fonts and a format scheme.

colors.description: The twelve theme colours in this order: dk1, lt1, dk2, lt2, accent1, accent2, accent3, accent4, accent5, accent6, hlink, folHlink.

cs.description: Font family for complex-script text; empty = the Latin one. Default empty.

ea.description: Font family for East Asian text; empty = the Latin one. Default empty.

latin.description: Font family for Latin text. Default empty.

scripts.description: Per-script fonts, in document order. Absent = none.

script.description: ISO 15924 script code, e.g. `Arab`. Default empty.

cs.description: Font family for complex-script text; empty = the Latin one. Default empty.

ea.description: Font family for East Asian text; empty = the Latin one. Default empty.

latin.description: Font family for Latin text. Default empty.

scripts.description: Per-script fonts, in document order. Absent = none.

script.description: ISO 15924 script code, e.g. `Arab`. Default empty.

format.description: The format scheme: what a shape's `style.*_ref.index` selects. Inside these entries the slot `phClr` stands for the referencing shape's `*_ref.color`.

bg_fills.description: Background fills: index 1001 = element 0, 1002, 1003. Default empty.

name.description: The theme's name. Default: the application's default theme name.

title_style.description: Text defaults of title placeholders (`title`, `ctrTitle`). Default empty.

role.description: What it is the master of: slides, notes pages or printed handouts.

schema_version.description: The revision of this payload's schema. Always 1.

title: core.slide.master
